exposure: Standardized post-cesarean analgesia regimen (scheduled acetaminophen and NSAIDs)
outcome: Cumulative oral morphine milligram equivalents (MME) used in the first 72 hours postoperatively
Total MME dose at 12, 24, and 48 hours
finding: Implementation of a standardized postoperative analgesic regimen with scheduled acetaminophen and NSAIDs significantly reduced cumulative opioid use in the first 72 hours after cesarean birth.
